sources.summary: Embo raised $110 million in seed funding to build a universal robot brain with world models. Its AI learns how the physical world works from internet video and practices motor skills in simulation. Google Deepmind, Meta, and MIT researchers are behind the startup as the race for general-purpose robotics AI accelerates. The article Robotics startup Embo raises $110 million in seed funding to build world-model AI for robots appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: Embo 籌集了 1.1 億美元的種子輪資金，旨在利用世界模型打造通用的機器人大腦。其人工智慧透過網際網路影片學習物理世界的運作方式，並在模擬環境中練習動作技能。Google Deepmind、Meta 以及麻省理工學院的研究人員是這家新創公司的幕後推手，隨著通用機器人人工智慧的競爭日益激烈。

sources.title_en: Google Deepmind's "Humanity's First Exam" shows top AI models still fail simple everyday tasks under repeated runs
sources.title_original: Google Deepmind's "Humanity's First Exam" shows top AI models still fail simple everyday tasks under repeated runs
sources.summary: Google Deepmind tests the reliability of 18 AI models with "Humanity's First Exam." Top models solve nearly every task family at least once, but even leaders like OpenAI's GPT-6.2 Astra stumble when asked for 16 straight correct answers. Visual perception accounts for 73 percent of errors, and more compute time doesn't fix the problem. The article Google Deepmind's "Humanity's First Exam" shows top AI models still fail simple everyday tasks under repeated runs appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: Google Deepmind 用「人類的第一場考試」測試了 18 個 AI 模型的可靠性。頂尖模型幾乎能至少解決一次所有的任務系列，但即使是像 OpenAI's GPT-6.2 Astra 這樣的領先者，在被要求連續給出 16 個正確答案時也會跌跤。視覺感知佔了錯誤的 73%，而且更多的運算時間並不能解決這個問題。

sources.title_original: OpenAI countersues Apple over trade secret theft and alleged coercion of shared suppliers
sources.summary: OpenAI is suing Apple in a California court, accusing it of trade secret theft and of coercing shared suppliers. The countersuit follows Apple's own lawsuit from the summer. Just two years ago, the two companies teamed up to bring ChatGPT to the iPhone. Now OpenAI is building its own devices to compete directly with Apple. The article OpenAI countersues Apple over trade secret theft and alleged coercion of shared suppliers appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: OpenAI 正在加州法院對 蘋果 提起訴訟，指控其竊取商業機密並強迫共同供應商。這起反訴繼承了 蘋果的 在今年夏天提起的訴訟。就在兩年前，這兩家公司還攜手將 ChatGPT 帶到 iPhone 上。現在 OpenAI 正在打造自己的裝置，以與 蘋果 直接競爭。

sources.title_en: Banned Nvidia Blackwell chips turn up in a Shanghai data center linked to Alice Huang, Bloomberg reports
sources.title_original: Banned Nvidia Blackwell chips turn up in a Shanghai data center linked to Alice Huang, Bloomberg reports
sources.summary: Two Chinese companies installed Nvidia's powerful Blackwell chips at a Shanghai data center linked to Alice Huang, according to a Bloomberg investigation. A serial number led Bloomberg to Taiwanese manufacturer Gigabyte. Exporting these chips to China without a US license is illegal. The article Banned Nvidia Blackwell chips turn up in a Shanghai data center linked to Alice Huang, Bloomberg reports appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: 根據彭博社（Bloomberg）的調查，兩家中國公司在與黃愛莉（Alice Huang）有關聯的一個上海資料中心安裝了輝達（Nvidia）強大的 Blackwell 晶片。一個序號將彭博社引導至臺灣製造商技嘉（Gigabyte）。在沒有美國許可的情況下將這些晶片出口到中國是非法的。

stories.title: OpenAI 正在建構「Athena」資料平臺以減少人工智慧代理程式的臆測 / OpenAI is building "Athena" data platform to cut down on AI agent guesswork

sources.title: OpenAI 正在建構「Athena」資料平臺以減少人工智慧代理程式的臆測 / OpenAI is building "Athena" data platform to cut down on AI agent guesswork
sources.title_zh: OpenAI 正在建構「Athena」資料平臺以減少人工智慧代理程式的臆測
sources.title_en: OpenAI is building "Athena" data platform to cut down on AI agent guesswork
sources.title_original: OpenAI is building "Athena" data platform to cut down on AI agent guesswork
sources.summary: OpenAI's data agent in ChatGPT Work still isn't accurate enough. Under the codename "Athena," the company is building a semantic layer that gives agents standardized definitions for business metrics. The tool could also put OpenAI in direct competition with Snowflake and Databricks. The article OpenAI is building "Athena" data platform to cut down on AI agent guesswork appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: OpenAI's 中的 ChatGPT 工作資料代理程式準確度仍不夠高。該公司正以「Athena」為代號建構一個語意層，為代理程式提供業務指標的標準化定義。此工具也可能讓 OpenAI 與 Snowflake 和 Databricks 展開直接競爭。

sources.summary: Yann LeCun is pushing forward with his alternative to language models through his startup AMI Labs. stories.title: Rockstar 的 AI 困境：《GTA 6》的分批發行模式能在編碼代理下存活嗎？ / Rockstar's AI dilemma: Can GTA 6's staggered release model survive coding agents?

sources.title: Rockstar 的 AI 困境：《GTA 6》的分批發行模式能在編碼代理下存活嗎？ / Rockstar's AI dilemma: Can GTA 6's staggered release model survive coding agents?
sources.title_zh: Rockstar 的 AI 困境：《GTA 6》的分批發行模式能在編碼代理下存活嗎？
sources.title_en: Rockstar's AI dilemma: Can GTA 6's staggered release model survive coding agents?
sources.title_original: Rockstar's AI dilemma: Can GTA 6's staggered release model survive coding agents?
sources.summary: More than 40 projects are working to bring a leaked Xbox build of GTA 6 to PC through reverse engineering just days after its $3.79 billion record console launch. AI coding agents like Claude Code are speeding up the process so much that an early unofficial multiplayer mode is already running. Rockstar's delayed PC business model is coming under pressure. The article Rockstar's AI dilemma: Can GTA 6's staggered release model survive coding agents? appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: 在《GTA 6》創下 37.9 億美元的主機發售紀錄幾天後，已有 40 多個專案正透過逆向工程，試圖將外流的主機版《GTA 6》移植到 PC 上。像 Claude Code 這樣的 AI 編碼代理正在大幅加速這個過程，以至於一個早期的非官方多人遊戲模式已經在運行。Rockstar 延遲的 PC 商業模式正面臨壓力。

sources.summary: Ant Group's Afu team open-sourced LingSante-3.1-flash, a 560B-parameter MoE medical AI model with 25B active parameters, a 1M-token context and an MIT license. It ranks first among open models on InclusionMed. The post Ant Group Releases LingSante-3.1-flash: An Open-Weight MoE Model with 560B Total Parameters and 25B Activations per Token appeared first on MarkTechPost .

sources.summary: 美國加州及伊利諾州等42名檢察長週二（11/24）宣佈，已聯手向破產法院提出異議，反對AI聊天機器人業者Character.AI於12月1日拍賣旗下平臺及逾2,100萬個美國使用者帳號的私人聊天紀錄，其中有超過210萬個帳號由未成年人註冊，且擬議交易並未提供任何使用者隱私保障措施。

events.news_summary: 傳NVIDIA暫停向東南亞四國出貨AI伺服器，因美國出口管制擴及遠端算力。

sources.title: NVIDIA 傳暫停向東南亞四國出貨 AI 伺服器，美國出口管制延伸至遠端算力
sources.title_zh: NVIDIA 傳暫停向東南亞四國出貨 AI 伺服器，美國出口管制延伸至遠端算力
sources.title_original: NVIDIA 傳暫停向東南亞四國出貨 AI 伺服器，美國出口管制延伸至遠端算力
sources.summary: 為防堵中國規避禁令，美國擴大半導體出口管制，範圍擴及遠端算力。傳NVIDIA已暫停對部分東南亞國家出貨AI伺服器，衝擊當地資料中心投資與營運，供應鏈面臨變數。

sources.title: 彭博社報導，被禁的輝達 Blackwell 晶片出現在與黃愛莉有關聯的上海資料中心 / Banned Nvidia Blackwell chips turn up in a Shanghai data center linked to Alice Huang, Bloomberg reports
sources.title_zh: 彭博社報導，被禁的輝達 Blackwell 晶片出現在與黃愛莉有關聯的上海資料中心
sources.title_en: Banned Nvidia Blackwell chips turn up in a Shanghai data center linked to Alice Huang, Bloomberg reports
sources.title_original: Banned Nvidia Blackwell chips turn up in a Shanghai data center linked to Alice Huang, Bloomberg reports
sources.summary: Two Chinese companies installed Nvidia's powerful Blackwell chips at a Shanghai data center linked to Alice Huang, according to a Bloomberg investigation. sources.title_en: Robotics startup Embo raises $110 million in seed funding to build world-model AI for robots
sources.title_original: Robotics startup Embo raises $110 million in seed funding to build world-model AI for robots
sources.summary: Embo raised $110 million in seed funding to build a universal robot brain with world models. Its AI learns how the physical world works from internet video and practices motor skills in simulation. Google Deepmind, Meta, and MIT researchers are behind the startup as the race for general-purpose robotics AI accelerates. The article Robotics startup Embo raises $110 million in seed funding to build world-model AI for robots appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: Embo 籌集了 1.1 億美元的種子輪資金，旨在利用世界模型打造通用的機器人大腦。其人工智慧透過網際網路影片學習物理世界的運作方式，並在模擬環境中練習動作技能。Google Deepmind、Meta 以及麻省理工學院的研究人員是這家新創公司的幕後推手，隨著通用機器人人工智慧的競爭日益激烈。

events.news_summary: GTA 6 主機版創下 37.9 億美元紀錄後，逾 40 個專案正逆向工程將洩漏的 Xbox 版本移植至 PC，AI 編碼代理加速了此過程。

sources.title: Rockstar 的 AI 困境：《GTA 6》的分批發行模式能在編碼代理下存活嗎？ / Rockstar's AI dilemma: Can GTA 6's staggered release model survive coding agents?

sources.title_original: Rockstar's AI dilemma: Can GTA 6's staggered release model survive coding agents?
sources.summary: More than 40 projects are working to bring a leaked Xbox build of GTA 6 to PC through reverse engineering just days after its $3.79 billion record console launch. AI coding agents like Claude Code are speeding up the process so much that an early unofficial multiplayer mode is already running. Rockstar's delayed PC business model is coming under pressure. The article Rockstar's AI dilemma: Can GTA 6's staggered release model survive coding agents? appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: 在《GTA 6》創下 37.9 億美元的主機發售紀錄幾天後，已有 40 多個專案正透過逆向工程，試圖將外流的主機版《GTA 6》移植到 PC 上。像 Claude Code 這樣的 AI 編碼代理正在大幅加速這個過程，以至於一個早期的非官方多人遊戲模式已經在運行。Rockstar 延遲的 PC 商業模式正面臨壓力。

sources.title_en: Google Deepmind's "Humanity's First Exam" shows top AI models still fail simple everyday tasks under repeated runs
sources.title_original: Google Deepmind's "Humanity's First Exam" shows top AI models still fail simple everyday tasks under repeated runs
sources.summary: Google Deepmind tests the reliability of 18 AI models with "Humanity's First Exam." Top models solve nearly every task family at least once, but even leaders like OpenAI's GPT-6.2 Astra stumble when asked for 16 straight correct answers. Visual perception accounts for 73 percent of errors, and more compute time doesn't fix the problem. The article Google Deepmind's "Humanity's First Exam" shows top AI models still fail simple everyday tasks under repeated runs appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: Google Deepmind 用「人類的第一場考試」測試了 18 個 AI 模型的可靠性。頂尖模型幾乎能至少解決一次所有的任務系列，但即使是像 OpenAI's GPT-6.2 Astra 這樣的領先者，在被要求連續給出 16 個正確答案時也會跌跤。視覺感知佔了錯誤的 73%，而且更多的運算時間並不能解決這個問題。

sources.title: 來自 Meta 與 AMI Labs 的三項研究支持 Yann LeCun 押注 JEPA 世界模型勝過大型語言模型 / Three studies from Meta and AMI Labs back Yann LeCun's bet on JEPA world models over large language models
sources.title_zh: 來自 Meta 與 AMI Labs 的三項研究支持 Yann LeCun 押注 JEPA 世界模型勝過大型語言模型
sources.title_en: Three studies from Meta and AMI Labs back Yann LeCun's bet on JEPA world models over large language models
sources.title_original: Three studies from Meta and AMI Labs back Yann LeCun's bet on JEPA world models over large language models
sources.summary: Yann LeCun is pushing forward with his alternative to language models through his startup AMI Labs. The JEPA architecture aims to give machines an internal world model that captures cause and effect. Three new studies show progress in robot planning, more efficient training, and error correction, though the pieces still need to grow together. The article Three studies from Meta and AMI Labs back Yann LeCun's bet on JEPA world models over large language models appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: Yann LeCun 正在透過他的新創公司 AMI Labs 推動語言模型的替代方案。JEPA 架構旨在賦予機器一個能夠捕捉因果關係的內在世界模型。三項新研究展示了在機器人規劃、更有效率的訓練以及錯誤修正方面的進展，儘管這些部分仍需要整合成長。

sources.title: OpenAI 針對竊取商業機密及涉嫌強迫共同供應商一事對 蘋果 提出反訴 / OpenAI countersues Apple over trade secret theft and alleged coercion of shared suppliers
sources.title_zh: OpenAI 針對竊取商業機密及涉嫌強迫共同供應商一事對 蘋果 提出反訴
sources.title_en: OpenAI countersues Apple over trade secret theft and alleged coercion of shared suppliers
sources.title_original: OpenAI countersues Apple over trade secret theft and alleged coercion of shared suppliers
sources.summary: OpenAI is suing Apple in a California court, accusing it of trade secret theft and of coercing shared suppliers. The countersuit follows Apple's own lawsuit from the summer. Just two years ago, the two companies teamed up to bring ChatGPT to the iPhone. Now OpenAI is building its own devices to compete directly with Apple. The article OpenAI countersues Apple over trade secret theft and alleged coercion of shared suppliers appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: OpenAI 正在加州法院對 蘋果 提起訴訟，指控其竊取商業機密並強迫共同供應商。這起反訴繼承了 蘋果的 在今年夏天提起的訴訟。就在兩年前，這兩家公司還攜手將 ChatGPT 帶到 iPhone 上。現在 OpenAI 正在打造自己的裝置，以與 蘋果 直接競爭。

spans.text: Robotics startup Embo raises $110 million in seed funding to build world-model AI for robots

Embo raised $110 million in seed funding to build a universal robot brain with world models. Its AI learns how the physical world works from internet video and practices motor skills in simulation. Google Deepmind, Meta, and MIT researchers are behind the startup as the race for general-purpose robotics AI accelerates.
